location_exception_reason: Beach house buyers are geographically constrained by coastal location; Goa, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, and Odisha are material purchase factors (CRZ compliance, local climate, tourism demand, accessibility). Location in title is a genuine product attribute, not seller metadata.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Dealer) are redundant in titles; IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this. Removing 'Manufacturer' from 'Prefab Beach House Manufacturer' leaves a complete product description. The product is the structure itself, not the business relationship.
